verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official Terraform provider or an equivalent infrastructure-as-code tool for managing Entra apps, groups, or Conditional Access policies declaratively. The Microsoft Graph API is a developer building block that someone could use to construct IaC tooling, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit. Managing an IdP as code is a fair question for this kind of product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the IdP is managed as code — an official Terraform provider (or equivalent) covers apps, groups, and policies so identity config is reviewable and reproducible
